label: A3B2C5DE2_mC104_15_3f_a3e_5f_f_2f-001
title: Vermiculite [Mg$_{2}$Si$_{2}$O$_{5}$(H$_{2}$O)$_{1.86}$(OH)Si$_{2}$] Structure
comments:
Many early works on the structure of vermiculite such as (Gruner, 1934)(ICSD 159384) put it in space group Cc \#9, but the structure is close enough to centrosymmetric space group $C2/c$ \#15 that AFLOW with the default tolerance puts the structure into higher symmetry structure. (Shirozu, 1966) give the structure in space group $C2/c$, so we use that for our definition. 
 In (Shirozu, 1966) the water molecule sites (labled H$_{2}$O here and shown a H in the JMOL image) are only occupied 62\% of the time. The sites we label as Si are actually 71.5\% silicon and 28.5\% aluminum. 
 JMOL renders the OH radical as an oxygen atom.  In the figure the OH radicals are bound to the magnesium atoms.  The ``O'' atoms bound to the silicon sites are actually oxygen.
